javadoc.description: The returned BitSet is not null and each element in the long array representation of the returned BitSet matches the corresponding element in the LongBuffer from its current position to its limit.
javadoc.state_representation:
param.lb.is_null: bool = lb==null
param.lb.position: int = lb.position()
param.lb.limit: int = lb.limit()
param.lb.remaining: int = lb.remaining()
param.lb.low: list[int], length = lb.limit(), element[i] = ((int)lb.get(i))
param.lb.high: list[int], length = lb.limit(), element[i] = ((int)(lb.get(i)>>32))
ret.is_null: bool = \result == null
ret.length: int = \result.length()
ret.cardinality: int = \result.cardinality()
ret.empty: bool = \result.isEmpty()
ret.bits: list[bool], length = \result.length(), element[i] = \result.get(i)
ret.words_low: list[int], length = \result.toLongArray().length, element[i] = ((int)\result.toLongArray()[i])
ret.words_high: list[int], length = \result.toLongArray().length, element[i] = ((int)(\result.toLongArray()[i] >> 32))
ret.bytes: list[int], length = \result.toByteArray().length, element[i] = ((int)\result.toByteArray()[i])

entry_schema.params: record[lb: record[is_null: bool, position: int, limit: int, remaining: int, low: list[int], high: list[int]]]

exit_schema.ret: record[is_null: bool, length: int, cardinality: int, empty: bool, bits: list[bool], words_low: list[int], words_high: list[int], bytes: list[int]]
